assign.outcome:
**Seven of my ten landed. The eighth — one schema — moved the bug rather than fixed it, and the realm has one live throw.**

**What is now genuinely true.** The configuration is in the address, and it works cold on every kind of page — I opened `/imagine/paging/room/wide/`, changed one word, and got `?navigation=columns`; `?navigation=rail&content=dashboard&surface=dark` opens cold with the right classes. `background` and `type` have urls at last ([surface](/imagine/paging/skin/surface/) · [background](/imagine/paging/skin/background/) · [type](/imagine/paging/skin/type/)), routed with no directories. `navigation` had five definitions and has one. The crossing is named, railed and drawn ([Cross](/imagine/paging/cross/)). The seed pages carry real words. The sheet is clean — of 154 classes, exactly one has no writer.

**The bug did not die; it changed hands.** Make now writes the seven words and migrates old nodes. **Build does not.** `build/words.js:116` is still `{style, content: "m", mech, kids, layout, arrange, blocks}` — the deleted `xs`–`xl` rung included — and I read that object out of the builder's own JSON box. Both editors write the same store, and `make/tabs.js:44` short-circuits on `mode.navigation`, which every Make page now has. So **Build's Navigation, Surface and Layout controls are no-ops on every page Make made** — and the rail tells the reader to open Make first and Build second.

**A live throw.** On [Make](/imagine/paging/make/), typing in the JSON box and pressing **Save** raises `ReferenceError: words is not defined` — `make/page.js:427` calls a function that is not imported, not defined and not exported by `/app.js`. Measured. It predates the fix pass.

**Still seven stage renderers**, plus four hand-built miniatures. Only `templates/` moved onto the real `draw` seam. So the line at `stage.js:24` and `readme.md:100` — *"there is no second renderer"* — is still untrue, though `doc/builder.md` now says so honestly.

**What still cannot be sent.** Build has no url at all. A nest that is not one of the twelve presets — including `/library/nest/`'s own nest, where I counted twelve chips, **zero lit**, and no way to take the nested page out. And the nine cells of the crossing wall: nine frames, **zero links**, on the one page where a cell now *is* a url.

**The two left items, ruled.**

- **`BuildStage` → `PagingStage`.** Worth it, not yet, and `doc/builder.md` has the order wrong — its own sketch reads `config: config_of(node)`, and Build's node carries none of the seven words. The blocker is the schema, not the seam. **Smallest first step: make Build speak the seven words.** It fixes a live break by itself and turns the 208-line merge into a mechanical one. `draw_child` after that.
- **`compare/`.** Drop it. `cross/` shipped and is the better version — nine live pages, not two. It lacks one line: wrap each cell in an `<a>` to `?navigation=X&arrangement=Y`. **Smallest first step: that anchor.**
